integrity: Analytic derivation of the complete inverse and its sharp two-moment obstruction; finite standalone checks are corroborative only; originality subject to uninspected earlier texts; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exact population moments of the planar-shadow perimeter of positive orthogonal boxes in R^3 under Haar orientations; the triple spherical constant is an exact integral, not claimed elementary; finite-sample and arbitrary-body uniqueness are not asserted.
title: Three perimeter moments reconstruct every rectangular box from unoriented random shadows
